parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Separate variables correctly and attempt integration of at least one side. B1
Obtain term $\ln x$. B1
Obtain term of the form $k\ln(3+\cos2\theta)$, or equivalent. M1
Obtain term $-\frac12\ln(3+\cos2\theta)$, or equivalent. A1
Use $x=3$, $\theta=\frac14\pi$ to evaluate a constant or as limits in a solution with terms $a\ln x$ and $b\ln(3+\cos2\theta)$, where $ab\ne0$. M1
State correct solution in any form, e.g. $\ln x=-\frac12\ln(3+\cos2\theta)+\frac32\ln3$. A1
Rearrange in a correct form, e.g. $x=\sqrt{\frac{27}{3+\cos2\theta}}$. A1
[7]
